And then, a rectangular TiAl part with a dimension of 70 mm (length) × 20 mm (width) × 40 mm (height) was fabricated by the SEBM method, as shown in Fig. 1 (a). The SEBM parameters are listed as follows: electron beam current = 10 – 12 mA, scanning speed = 3.5 – 4.5 m/s, hatch spacing = 100 μm, and preheating temperature of the substrate = 1100 ◦ C. Scanning was conducted in a snake-like path with a 90 ◦ rotation between layers, and the layer thickness was varied in the range of 50 – 100 μm.

evidence.quote: After preheating at 1150 ◦ C for 90 min, the sample was forged at a reduction of 10% along the building direction (BD). After forging, the samples were wrapped with thermal insulation cotton and slowly cooled to room temperature (cooling rate ≤ 30 ◦ C/s).
The small-strain forging improved the high temperature strength and ductility of as-built TiAl alloy.
